prompt:
Create one subject-only editorial illustration for a premium packaging-engineering article thumbnail.

Visual language: cinematic three-dimensional industrial product rendering; physically plausible scale and perspective; clean corrugated cardboard, painted steel, timber pallet, and cargo materials where applicable; crisp controlled edges; realistic contact shadows; restrained glossy studio floor; directional key light with soft teal rim light; deep near-black and teal atmosphere compatible with later compositing.

Composition: keep all meaningful subject matter in the right half of a 16:9 frame; preserve the entire left 46 percent as calm, dark negative space; use a three-quarter or isometric-like camera; one coherent scene; strong silhouette; readable at small card size.

The final card renderer adds every word and all branding. Generate no text, letters, numbers, symbols, labels, logos, screens, watermarks, people, decorative infographic elements, charts, UI fragments, or clutter. Do not imply that an illustrative arrangement is an exact solver output.

Scene-family direction: One optimized logistics subject or a restrained physical before-and-after cue, with no visibly countable claim unless verified.
Article-specific subject: an open blue-grey high-cube shipping container with a dense orderly mixed-cargo load and a small additional group moving into plausible residual space; conceptual cargo with no exact visibly countable total
Allowed physical subjects: shipping_container, cargo_module, pallet
Camera: three-quarter product-studio view looking along the open high-cube container and into its cargo
Materials: blue-grey painted steel container, warm corrugated cartons, muted blue, orange, white, and teal cargo modules, restrained timber pallets, realistic clean industrial surfaces
Lighting: cinematic soft key light from upper left, teal rim light, subtle warm cargo highlights, controlled contact shadows
Blending strategy: transparent_alpha
Additional exclusions: text, letters, numbers, logos, vendor branding, people, screenshots, watermarks, visible exact cargo count, winner badges, charts, clutter

Use the attached approved nine-tile KolliLabs board only as the visual style reference. Produce exactly one subject-only cutout for the high-cube residual-capacity card, not a finished thumbnail and not a collage. Preserve clean alpha around the physical scene. Do not reproduce any board text, logo, border, panel, background, or layout.
rollback_target: Existing published article thumbnail/front matter remain unchanged.
